notes.title: Update v[1.1.2.053]
notes.notes:
1- Money Textures
As it's highly requested, all money textures are changed. Hopefully, they look better than before :)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45099365/5704752f66d34edc5605adbb8c4127260c9f1360.png

2- Store Closed
After 22.00, the store is closed automatically.
If the store is closed, new customers will come to the door but won't enter.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45099365/89cc65b9957e396163460660b7a180be5a1db7eb.png

3- NPC Movements
Customers move faster.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45099365/ef6adc18dc135b38a018fa187844719f5fa25777.png

4- Cash Register
Some customers give the exact amount now. So it's enough to take the money and press "Space Bar" (by default).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45099365/efdaa0e83d92f39888b75ae5f6774fcc93288750.png

5- Tutorial
In the tutorial, there is extra information about "First Checkout".
You should press "Space Bar" (by default) to complete any checkout process.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45099365/bc0ab07f69877a4c8f48ad9f9e2c68d311fc05fc.png

6- Market Price Changes
The list of the market-price-changed products shows the previous day's market-price-changed products. You'd better check their prices as well.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45099365/b2db8d65ee3f8b57c82459cf3663bf2041ad3c79.jpg

7- Language
Arabic language is added.
Russian localization is updated.


By the way, the full game is out now!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3089130/Retail_Company_Simulator/

notes.title: Update v[1.1.2.035]
notes.notes:
1- Optimization
The game is optimized for better performance on low-level systems.
Game crashing when opening a box issue fixed
Clicking lags issue fixed
"LowLevelFatalError" crash issue fixed

2- Higher Moving Speed
Movement speed is increased both for walking and sprinting (sprint is Left Shift by default).

3- Clothes Placement
The direction of the clothes during the placement on shelves is fixed.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45099365/097c326c7fbbf30214677947b640055403eebe59.jpg

4- Inventory Menu "Add to Cart"
"Add to Cart" option is added to the Inventory Menu. You can check your inventory (in your store and stock) and add to your cart any product on the Inventory Menu.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45099365/b7d61258336ec8460bf3e8ebf536d4478819d583.jpg

5- Undo Action in the Trash
You can take back your last box by clicking the trash.
If you accidentally put a box (with some products inside) into the trash, you can take it with a click.
Also, if you need an empty box, you can have one from the trash with a click.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45099365/46551030fd6f299ab2642e0e6609448062ae1355.jpg

Older Savegames are not compatible with this version.

Thank you so much for your support and feedback
